## Project Context

The goal of this project, is to take the specifications that the Lloyd's Market Association have for the data model for Computable Binding Authority Agreement, build a series of semantic ontologies to describe the  implementation of the various modules, and create layers of abstraction that model the executable semantics using an appropriate DL fragment. 

## Task

Please review the data model reflected in [reference/lma-wordings-information-model.md](reference/lma-wordings-information-model.md), and build an initial ontological structure in `ontology` to support our exploration of this subject matter, using OWL 2. 

Please keep in mind that these are (eventually) going to be _executable contracts_, which is why we are using an Description Logic fragment.

## References / See Also

[Lattice](https://github.com/nebularis/lattice) is a layered semantic framework we shall baseline on in a future iteration. At this point it is merely a reference, DO NOT implement on top of it at this point in time.
